input.content: Design one VEX-inspired four-wheel skid-steer chassis. Return a specification, concise rationale, predicted benefit, and a quantitative testable hypothesis. You may change only schema parameters. No claims of official legality or verified hardware performance. Use results honestly. Obey cross-field geometry constraints. Battery and optional ballast coordinates are meters.

{"operation": "initial", "engineering_context": {"scope": "Synthetic engineering benchmark; approximate VEX-inspired system, not official Override field or legality validation.", "units": "SI: meters, kilograms, seconds, radians, N m. Local +x forward, +y left, +z up. Frame origin at axle height.", "dimensions": "Frame dimensions are outer edges; wheelbase and track are wheel-center distances. Tire width 0.025 m. Footprint width=track+0.025, length=max(frame_length,wheelbase+diameter), both <=0.4572 m.", "geometry_rules": "track >= frame_width+0.035; diameter+0.020 <= wheelbase <= frame_length-0.040. Battery 0.120 x 0.065 m; ballast 0.050 x 0.050 m; both inside frame with 0.005 m margins, and separated by 0.005 m if ballast included.", "fixed_components": "Four motors, one per wheel (0.28 kg each), four 0.12 kg tires, one fixed 0.35 kg battery. Optional fixed 0.30 kg ballast. No other actuators.", "frame_mass": "0.65 + 2.0*(frame_length_m+frame_width_m) kg: conservative lumped frame/electronics/support allowance. Frame solid box, 0.025 m thick; primitive volumes are inertia surrogates, not material manufacturing geometry.", "inertia": "MuJoCo derives rigid-body COM and inertia from component primitive masses and positions, including parallel-axis shifts. Motors sit below frame; battery and ballast above. Tires are solid-cylinder inertia approximations.", "motor_model": "Approximate 1.05 N m stall torque at 200 rpm; scale inverse to allowed 100/200/600 rpm. omega0=rpm*2*pi/60. Voltage u=clip(omega_target/omega0+0.8*(omega_target-omega),-1,1); torque=clip(stall*(u-omega/omega0),-stall,stall). Symmetric current cap, ideal braking. No thermal limits, battery sag or V5 firmware.", "contact": "Rigid cylinders, isotropic Coulomb sliding friction, condim=3, elliptic cone, no hidden forces. Four fixed parallel axles create physical lateral scrub during skid steering. No omni-wheel or tire compliance approximation. Friction varies uniformly 0.55..0.80 per trial, all contacting geoms use that coefficient.", "physics": "MuJoCo implicitfast, gravity 9.81 m/s^2, 0.002 s timestep, 60 solver iterations, wheel damping 0.001 N m s/rad and armature 0.0001 kg m^2.", "controller": "Fixed SI-unit bearing controller; 0.85 m/s speed cap, 1.8 rad/s yaw command cap; suppress forward motion when heading error >0.4 rad. All candidates use same gains with radius, track and free-speed conversions. No per-candidate tuning; baseline development used development seeds only.", "course": "Enclosed arena x=-0.75..6.45, y=-1.75..1.75 m. Ordered targets (2,0),(2.65,0.60),(3.45,-0.60),(4.25,0.60),(5.1,0),(5.65,0). Three 0.14 m radius posts at (2.65,-0.30),(3.45,0.30),(4.25,-0.30). Start near (0,0), heading 0.", "completion": "45 s timeout. First target requires speed<0.045 m/s for 0.35 s; slalom targets within 0.11 m in order; parking within 0.085 m with heading error<0.10 rad, speed<0.045 m/s, yaw rate<0.10 rad/s for 0.5 s. Parking heading 0 rad.", "metrics": "Tracking RMS is time-sampled distance to current ordered segment. Progress combines completed target count and clipped segment projection, capped <1 until all stops and parking pass. Wheel travel integrates absolute angular travel times radius. Saturation is fraction of motor-timesteps at voltage limit. Contacts separated by >0.25 s per hazard count as new collision episodes.", "ranking": "Lexicographically minimize [-clean completions,-completions,unstable runs,collision episodes,-mean progress,mean completion time with 45s for failures,mean RMS error].
